fixture_popularity._readme: Match popularity score = competition weight x (0.5 + club A + club B) x rivalry multiplier; European ties with no UK club are multiplied by no_uk_club_multiplier. A judgement-based proxy for how much UK interest a match draws, not a measured audience. Edit the weights and lists to taste.

fixtures._readme: Edit by hand. type: football | racing | darts | rugby | tournament | tv | regulation | other. tier 1 = market-moving, 2 = notable. end is optional. approx: true means the start or end date is expected, not confirmed. Fixtures and TV schedules move, so re-check before planning around them.
